title: GG Aura
description: A mod that automatically says gg after Hypixel games end.
body:
**GG Aura** is client-side Fabric mod that automatically sends "gg" in the chat after Hypixel games end.

The trigger words come from Sk1er's AutoGG (GPLv3).

_There are no options that can be configured for now._
***
While auto GG features are generally allowed on Hypixel, use this mod at your own risk.
